rows.doc: Generation works a hex of this radius at a time (217 tiles).
Region centres sit on a lattice this far apart. provisional: the GDD's 6 gives a median region of 35 tiles and half the land outside 19 to 37 (spike E round 3); 5 keeps 70% inside.
provisional: not in the GDD yet; spike value (spike E round 3): how far the seed moves a region centre.
provisional: not in the GDD yet; spike value (spike E round 3): how far a tile looks for a region centre of its own biome before it takes the nearest centre.
provisional: not in the GDD yet; spike value (spike E round 3): a region's biome is the most common one within this many tiles of its centre.
provisional: spike E round 5: a centre that would take fewer tiles than this takes none, and its tiles go to their next choice.
provisional: spike E round 5: no centre takes a tile beyond the largest disc that holds at most this many tiles.
provisional: not in the GDD yet; spike value (spike E round 4): how far the domain warp moves where elevation and moisture are read.
provisional: spike E round 5: how far the continent layer sinks land at its lowest, in elevation points.
provisional: spike E round 6: where the continent layer is below this, land sinks toward the sea; 52 gives about a quarter of tiles water (58 gave a third).
provisional: spike E round 5: the narrowest fade margin, in elevation and moisture points; at 0 or less an edge is sharp.
provisional: spike E round 4: the widest fade margin.
provisional: spike E round 4: ecotone tiles of one pair a region needs to hold that edge's material and creatures.
provisional: spike E round 4: share of edge regions whose edge creature is a variant of the pair.
Spine nodes sit on a lattice this far apart, each joined to its six neighbours.
provisional: spike E round 5: how far the seed moves a spine node, to dry land where it can.
provisional: spike E round 5: steps a corridor may wander beyond its detour share, so short ones can bend too.

provisional: spike E round 5: what a corridor pays per tile that must yield: more than any route over land inside its ellipse, so it never crosses water or peaks when a way round under about 3 times as long exists, and crosses with the fewest yielded tiles otherwise.
provisional: spike E round 5: how long a corridor may be against the straight walk between its ends.
provisional: spike E round 5: along a crossing over water, every this many tiles an island rises with the tiles round it.
provisional: spike E round 7: places afloat (in water, or cut off from their spine node by it) this close to each other form one group, which reaches the shore by a single crossing.
provisional: spike E round 7: a group of places afloat bigger than this is no group: each of its places runs to its own spine node.
provisional: spike E round 5: a dry component of the spine lattice no bigger than a disc of this many hops is an island, and gets a link across the water.
provisional: spike E round 5: how many spine spacings an island looks for land to link to.
A river runs downhill for at most this many tiles.
provisional: not in the GDD yet; spike value (spike E round 3): a chunk's highest tile starts a river only from this elevation up.
provisional: not in the GDD yet; spike value (spike E round 3): share of chunks with a high enough top tile that start a river.
Starting settlements sit on a lattice this far apart.
provisional: not in the GDD yet; spike value (spike E round 3): how far the seed moves a starting settlement; under half the spacing, so nearest-first order is exact.
provisional: not in the GDD yet; spike value (spike E round 3): starting settlements keep this far outside the areas of origin-anchored patterns.
Region tier rises one per this many tiles from the nearest open starting settlement (settled 2026-11-17).
Region tier rises to this and no further; raised only by decision (GDD 4.17).
One region in this many has a dungeon.
Far materials appear past this distance from the origin.
provisional: not in the GDD yet; spike value (spike E round 3): each biome has its own far material per lattice cell this wide.
A far material's vector is at least this share of its tier's budget.
provisional: not in the GDD yet; spike value (spike E round 3): axes a far material's profile spreads over.
provisional: not in the GDD yet; spike value (spike E round 3): share of regions whose creature is a variant.
Cover strays this far either side of its terrain's, by the cover noise.
Ore richness rises above this elevation and falls below it: ore sits in hills (GDD 4.2).
Ore points per elevation point from the mid.
Fertility rises with moisture above this and falls below it.
Fertility points per moisture point from the mid.
A river's first tiles from its source are a stream.
Kinds of material a region holds (GDD 4.2).
Draw weight of a material whose tags match the region's biome.
Draw weight of any other material.
Share of land regions with a landmark of their own, on their highest free tile.
Beats on a dungeon floor, at the fewest.
And at the most.
Forks whose second way stands behind a machine.
Haul a floor reached through a solved fork machine adds.
